paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.62% on average, with Nikkei 225 strongest (+2.40%) and Euro Stoxx 50 weakest (-0.34%). Brent crude changed +0.60% to 102.86. Gold changed +0.59% to 4,187.0. Bitcoin changed -0.56% to 86,000.0. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.277%, a relative move of +0.76%. Among the firms tracked, 3i Group (-4.27%) and Freeport-McMoRan (+3.98%) moved the most.
